verdict.rationale: The evidence shows local execution: `dg dev` starts a local webserver (dagster-docs-35), projects are scaffolded with create-dagster (dagster-docs-18), and asset checks act as data tests (dagster-docs-27). Community posts praise local development, and a Dagster team member describes the goal as a laptop-to-prod experience with business logic separated from environmental concerns. One user also reports running Dagster with DuckDB as a lightweight stack. Missing for 10: first-party docs on swapping destinations or resources per environment (local DuckDB vs prod warehouse), unit-testing docs for running assets in-process, and hands-on corroboration of a local-to-prod promotion workflow.
